en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
I've gotten used to being here...
I want to get outside as soon as I can...
Staying here forever wouldn't be so bad

But that does not mean it is alright for us
to stay here forever.

People fear stagnation... If you are swallowed
by complacency, then you will forget to fight.

Please, you must continue to remember
your desire to escape.
You must not be tamed.
Yes, I feel the same as well...

Our memories may be gone, but our consciousness
remains. Before being trapped, I served someone.

I cannot forgive myself for abandoning
my duties.

Shuichi...
We must escape this academy.

That is impossible...
Please do not say such terrible things.

Have you completed all your duties
in the outside world?

No... Even if you did, that cannot be the
reason you wish to stay here.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kirumi looks deep in thought...
(How should I...?)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kirumi's inner thoughts...?
